name: Scooty
summary: In Booty Bay, Scooty runs a teleport link to Gnomeregan from the busy pirate port. The goblin engineer calls himself a master of his craft and keeps transponders tied to an experimental pad in the fallen gnome city. His device gives Horde forces a perilous route into Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Booty Bay's Teleportation Expert
sections.body: Scooty holds court among Booty Bay’s wharves and workshops as one of the Steamwheedle Cartel’s most ambitious tinkerers. While many goblins favor gunpowder and explosives, he has turned to moving matter across great distances. He calibrates transponders to keep a working link with a teleportation pad inside Gnomeregan. Horde forces rely heavily on his craft to reach the subterranean gnome stronghold without crossing dangerous Alliance territory.

sections.title: Gnomish Gadgets and Goblin Risk
sections.body: Keeping experimental goblin teleporters running is rarely dull. After hearing of a new gnomish rig in Gnomeregan, Scooty and his partner Sovik built the Transpolyporter 6000. Scooty cheerfully admits it has exploded a dozen or so times. Crossing continents as scattered matter carries clear physical dangers, yet Scooty remains sure of his genius. He treats every mechanical failure as a small obstacle on the road to innovation.

faq.answer: Scooty is a goblin engineer in Booty Bay who claims to be a master engineer. He maintains and calibrates the Goblin Transponder network, which links the port to an experimental teleportation pad deep inside Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why does Scooty have a teleporter to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Scooty linked Booty Bay to an experimental teleportation pad inside Gnomeregan to allow direct travel into the gnome city. For the Horde, the device offers a vital route into Dun Morogh without crossing the heavily fortified Alliance homelands.
Scooty works in Booty Bay, the neutral goblin port at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.
Scooty’s teleporter successfully sends adventurers into Gnomeregan, but its workings can go awry. Mechanical mishaps and miscalibrated transponders make each trip a hazard.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can use Scooty’s indispensable shortcut into Gnomeregan to bypass Alliance defenses in Dun Morogh.
As an engineer, you can appreciate Scooty’s audacious use of transponder physics, though goblin disregard for safety makes every activation a gamble.
